_why: Skill-candidates row 'name the tests that PARSE a document you are about to edit': a doc-derived test lives beside its consumer, so a targeted slice misses it and the push goes red in the full suite. `h_mad_doc_consumers.py` names those tests and the advisory pre-commit hook prints them. These rows prove the tests bite if matching loses its directory rule, test files are treated as documents, a failed git call reads as 'nobody reads this', or the hook starts blocking commits.

mutations.name: basename-alone-is-a-consumer
mutations._mechanism: Every test naming any SKILL.md reads every SKILL.md: the RUN line fills with unrelated files and stops being trusted.
mutations.find: if not top or Path(rel).parts[0] == top or top in text:

mutations.name: only-same-directory-readers-count
mutations._mechanism: The cross-skill reader, the case the row records, is dropped.
mutations.find: if not top or Path(rel).parts[0] == top or top in text:
mutations.replace: if not top or Path(rel).parts[0] == top:

mutations.name: test-files-count-as-documents
mutations._mechanism: A staged test file is reported as a document, burying the real ones.
mutations.find: return not rel.endswith(".py") and "tests" not in parts[:-1]
mutations.replace: return "tests" not in parts[:-1] or True

mutations.name: git-failure-reads-as-no-consumers
mutations._mechanism: Fail-open: outside git the script says nothing reads the document instead of UNKNOWN.

mutations.name: hook-blocks-the-commit
mutations._mechanism: An advisory turns into a gate: every commit touching a read document is refused.
mutations.find: printf '[pre-commit] tests that read the documents you are committing:\n%s\n' "$OUT" >&2 ;;
mutations.replace: printf '[pre-commit] tests that read the documents you are committing:\n%s\n' "$OUT" >&2; exit 1 ;;

mutations.name: live-run-warning-blocks-the-commit
mutations._mechanism: The live-run advisory turns into a gate: a commit is refused because another lane is mid-cycle, a judgement the row says must stay the operator's.
mutations.replace: *) printf '[pre-commit] h-mad runs live elsewhere:\n%s\n' "$OUT" >&2; exit 1 ;;

mutations.name: live-run-warning-is-never-printed
mutations._mechanism: The sender-side warning the row asks for is silently dropped.
